verdict.rationale: Fly.io documents a fully-managed Postgres service (Managed Postgres) with automatic backups and recovery and high availability with automatic failover. The docs do not explicitly mention point-in-time recovery or user-provisionable read replicas. Community reports of Postgres machines going down describe older self-run Postgres machines and a single-host failure, so they do not concretely contradict the Managed Postgres HA claim; they only lower confidence. Missing for 10: explicit point-in-time recovery documentation, explicit replica provisioning, in-depth docs on HA topology, independent hands-on corroboration of Managed Postgres.

support.subject: As a developer, I can provision a fully-managed Postgres database with point-in-time recovery, replicas, and high availability

citations.quote: Fly.io's Managed Postgres is our fully-managed database service that handles all aspects of running production PostgreSQL databases
